fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is the sole selectable proposal, but no hash-locked product-tagged NAND/COPY candidate, complete integer matrix, factor, target, or legal energy E currently exists. Its experiment must stop and kill the candidate if these data cannot be serialized unambiguously.

Proposal 2 is premature and is killed for this run. The inequality 2r>=q does not show that admissible product-evaluation rows span the quotient dual, while adding tags changes the kernel and can create new Lawrence moves; the mandated single-tag full-matrix audit must occur first.

Proposal 3 reverts to a linear quotient checksum and has no protection against G13 or a toric exchange lying in the saturated honest subgroup H. It also does not establish that its quotient map and regular-simplex realization are simultaneously integral, emitted, and common-energy.

Proposal 4 cannot decide the claimed product-tag family from only certified low-energy primitives because the Graver basis changes with the specialization. Without the complete emitted matrix and a terminating complete CEGIS universe, either satisfiability or infeasibility would be incomplete.

Proposal 5 does not make finite-state semantics valid for unrestricted signed integral flows. G19 already demonstrates that linearly emitted transition constraints admit accepting signed circulations, and testing a frozen 4x2 seam would not certify full-tile reachability or energy.

Proposal 6 has no justified compositional orientation theorem: an adverse deviation's conformal decomposition need not consist solely of primitives carrying the chosen orientation. Moreover, the current transfer lives in a finite residue space with no rational order functional, so this abandons rather than repairs Q1-Q2.

Proposal 7 skips the Q1 frontier and supplies no finite closed state partition, coercive tail bound, or complete unrestricted transition set. A shell SDP/LP on one COPY seam cannot establish arbitrary-depth closure or escape the observed DROP, parity, and lambda<=mu obstructions.

The supplied gate unanimously requires the full-matrix fixed-witness lift audit before multiple tags, P^3 analysis, or a complete Graver computation. No common legal energy, DROP bound, shell certificate, Q1 lemma, or asymptotic gap is verified.
